title: Affine morphisms
statement:
A morphism of schemes $f:X\to S$ [def-pc-scheme] is *affine* if for every affine
open $V\subset S$ the preimage $f^{-1}(V)$ is an affine open of $X$ (affine in the sense of [def-pc-scheme]).
(*Stacks Project, Morphisms of Schemes, Definition 29.11.1, Tag
[01S6](https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/01S6).*)
